notes.title: Version 1.0 - Final Release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34471159/9da7a23379a0d143e0c0d0457e456ef5bdd8e7f1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi Everyone,[/b][/h1]

Magic Gun is out of Early Access now! In Final Release, I have make some modifications to the Achievements. Most of the Achievements will be easier to Unlock.
Please feel free to try it out!


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Add 5 New Achievements
[/list]
[h1][b]Modifications[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Attacker
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Monster Hunter
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Fire Master
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Ice Master
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Light Master
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Gem Collector
[*] Drop down requirement to unlock Endless Player
[/list]
[h1][b]Bugs Fix[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where ally sometime cannot attack the monsters on sky
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.8 - Slime
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34471159/08f15dfd681af0fdd26e32936ed8a16072e57824.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi Everyone,[/b][/h1]

In Version 0.8, I have add [b]Slime[/b] into the game! [b]Slime[/b] is a new special monster which have 3 types.
Different types of Slime have Resistance to Different Magic. You Need to Pick a right magic to deal a good damage to them.
You may find them in Level 21-25. Please feel free to try it out!


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Add New Monster - Red Slime
[*] Add New Monster - Blue Slime
[*] Add New Monster - Green Slime
[*] Add New Monster - Boss Slime
[*] Add Level 21-25
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.6 - Ally System
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34471159/722d673e0fb1e0c8a14fdbcfec1559e0358dcdde.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi Everyone,[/b][/h1]

In Version 0.6, I have add [b]Ally System[/b] into the game! You may hire allies at Ally Page after clearing Level 10. The allies can help you to attack the monsters when they enter the attack range.
Also, you may unlock some [b]New Achievements[/b] when you hire the allies! Please feel free to try it out!


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Archer can be hired at Ally Page
[*] Mage can be hired at Ally Page
[*] Ally System will be unlocked after clear Level 10
[*] Add 5 New Achievements
[/list]

Also, I have make some improvement for the game. Please feel free to try it out!


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Add New Monster - Treasure Chest

[/list]
[h1][b]Modifications[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhance Ability will be unlocked after clear Level 03
[*] New Fire Bullet Effect
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.4 - Enhance Ability
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34471159/4eda6caf00b02964900419c98414146d1699a65b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi Everyone,[/b][/h1]

In Version 0.4, I have add [b]Enhance Ability[/b] into the game! 
All Monsters in the game will drop Magic Gems when Dead. Those Gems will be collected automatically! You may use the Magic Gems to Enhance your Magic Gun. The Enhance Page is located above the Level Select Buttons.
In the future, the Magic Gems will be the main resources in the game. Let's collect Magic Gems as much as you can now!
Also, you may unlock some [b]New Achievements[/b] when collecting the Magic Gems or enhancing the Magic Gun! Please feel free to try it out!


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Monsters will drop Magic Gems when Dead
[*] The Magic Gun can be enhanced by Magic Gems at Enhance Page
[*] Add 10 New Achievements
[/list]
[h1][b]Modifications[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fire Bullet can keep shooting when holding Trigger
[*] Ice Bullet can keep shooting when holding Trigger
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3 - Monster Skill
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34471159/35b51fd57cb451cd40b69ee862c26a0ab13b28f1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hi Everyone,[/b][/h1]

In Version 0.3, I have add [b]Monster Skill[/b] into the game! Some Monsters may perform special action in the attack. You may discover it when meeting those monsters.
Please feel free to try it out!


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Rock Golem can Open a Protection Barrier
[*] Reaper can Teleport for a short distance
[*] Cactus Monster can Jump for a short distance
[*] Add Obelisk Appear Effect
[/list]
[h1][b]Modifications[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Ice Bullet can freeze all monsters in a small area
[*] Ice Master require more Ice Bullet hit to unlock
[*] Decrease Health of Rock Golem
[*] Decrease Health of Reaper
[*] Decrease Health of Cactus Monster
[/list]
